decisions.reason: The charting bundle is a low-cost plugin on the map.apps platform. It had no observed presence in 2020-2021, which weakens the signal about its value, but bundles like this are usually kept as part of the platform portfolio.

The hierarchical search bundle got only a brief mention and has had no visibility since, so its value looks doubtful. Still, it costs little to maintain within the platform, so keeping the option open remains marginally justified.

VueTOC was a small, experimental-looking mobile component announced once and not seen since. Its value appears unrealized, and mobile map control is likely absorbed into newer platform releases, so abandoning it frees resources.
The software platform is the firm's flagship and strategic core, a committed investment rather than a marginal option, so abandoning it is very unlikely.
Mobile field data capture fits enduring demand from public-sector and utility customers and has its own page. Its prospects justify keeping it despite the lack of recent observations.

The search extension sits close to the core offer with low maintenance cost. There is no clear evidence of failure, so the option stays open, although its overlap with other search bundles adds some risk of consolidation.
